name: EPIC 202809947
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 2, 16.1 solar radii and 0.85 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 202809947 (K2 campaign 2): PARAM radius (solar radii) 16.075725 (16th-84th percentiles 15.697581-16.653134), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 202809947: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4382.9697 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 202809947 (K2 campaign 2): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 3974.960938 (16th-84th percentiles 3898.28125-4066.5625), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 3,975 parsecs away, 16 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 2, give 0.85 solar masses and 16.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,383 K at its surface.
